generator.independence: pure Dart; no package:yuv_ffi, FFI, native symbols, or WASM imports
generator.updatePolicy: Fixtures change only through an explicit generator run and manifest/artifact diff review.

decoded.colorSpaceAssumption: PNG samples are interpreted as sRGB, straight alpha; encoded reference PNGs retain the decoded 8-bit RGBA samples.

compatibility.nv21: The public legacy nv21 label is intentionally UV/NV12-like: each chroma pair is U then V. Do not silently change this order based on the label.
compatibility.yuvConversion: BT.601 limited-range 4:2:0 reference; chroma is the integer average of each 2x2 source block.

exact.rationale: Metadata, raw construction/serialization bytes, channel reorder, plane-only transforms, and exact RGB transforms are integer-preserving.

yuvRoundTrip.rationale: 4:2:0 chroma subsampling is lossy; bounds are fixed before backend execution and allow edge-local chroma error while rejecting broad color drift.

nv21RoundTrip.rationale: Legacy UV compatibility paths have historically used a wider conversion envelope; this is predeclared, not tuned from a backend run.

blur.rationale: Independent kernels use clamp-to-edge borders and rounded samples. Small fixed integer-kernel implementation differences are allowed, alpha remains exact.

blurPlanar.rationale: F-011 (engineering decision 2026-09-20): the reference generator blurs the source RGBA image directly at full resolution, while I420/NV21 blur goes through a 4:2:0 YUV round-trip first, so chroma is blurred at half resolution and reconstructed by subsampling. That is a structural methodology gap between the oracle and the YUV-domain pipeline, not an implementation defect on either side. Measured on all 16 planar BOX/MEAN/GAUSSIAN cases (I420 and NV21) with every known native/Dart-wiring defect fixed: mae 4.738-9.007, maxChannelError up to 149 (MEAN_DEFAULT), percentile99ChannelError up to 129 (BOX_RECT/MEAN_RECT). These bounds keep roughly 10-20% margin over the worst observed value in each metric so the tolerance accepts the structural gap without masking a real regression, which would need to push well past this margin (border-semantics-class defects previously measured far higher). Applies only to I420/NV21 planar blur; BGRA8888 blur stays under the tight "blur" tolerance above, since it has no subsampling step and reference/actual already agree at mae=0.000.

effectPlanar.rationale: F-012 (engineering decision 2026-09-20, YUV-44): the reference artifact applies grayscale/blackwhite/negate directly to the original RGBA source, while I420/NV21 effects operate on an already 4:2:0-encoded frame and are compared back through a second BT.601 limited decode. That stacks the unavoidable encode/decode quantization of the initial RGBA->YUV construction on top of the effect itself, which is a structural methodology gap between the oracle and the YUV-domain pipeline, not an implementation defect. It manifests differently per effect: (1) blackwhite thresholds a gray value at 128; the BT.601 gray weights (299/587/114) and luma weights (66/129/25) are only proportional, not bit-identical, so a small, fixed set of pixels whose true gray sits within 1 LSB of the boundary land on the opposite side after the encode round trip and flip fully black<->white (max channel error 255, the hard ceiling for a binary output; measured 256/262144 pixels on I420 and NV21, mae 0.187, p99 0 - the flips are isolated, not broad drift). (2) negate is linear and has no hard boundary, so its error is smooth: measured mae 6.223, max 131, p99 131, 17408/262144 pixels outside the prior 96-pixel yuvRoundTrip ceiling. Grayscale is exempt: recomputing gray directly from the decoded pixel and re-encoding keeps it inside the existing yuvRoundTrip bounds (mae 0.178, max 1), so it is not covered by this tolerance. Bounds here cover blackwhite's binary worst case exactly (255) and keep roughly 20% margin over negate's measured mae/p99 so the tolerance accepts the structural gap without masking a real regression. Applies only to I420/NV21 blackwhite and negate; BGRA8888 stays exact (no YUV round trip), and I420/NV21 grayscale stays under yuvRoundTrip.
